sources.title: Envoy external authorization v3 API
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Envoy SDS：秘密更新、確認與實際握手採用
related.titleEn: Envoy SDS: secret updates, acknowledgements and handshake adoption
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：50與10毫秒可重算，deny、5xx與逾時均不因有餘裕而授權；明確列出哪些設定是課堂政策。 交付ext-authz-timing.csv、四類回應矩陣與v3設定摘要；全部測試離線，不呼叫真實授權端點。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reproduce 50 and ten milliseconds, never turn deny, 5xx or timeout into permission, and identify the settings selected by classroom policy. Deliver ext-authz-timing.csv, the four-response matrix and a v3 configuration summary. All tests are offline and contact no real authorization endpoint.
related.difference: 建立舊新憑證公開描述、SDS版本、ACK/NACK及握手serial表；另外記錄SDS連線自身的bootstrap信任，避免用尚未取得的秘密循環建立初始信任。
related.differenceEn: Build old/new public certificate descriptors, SDS versions, ACK/NACK events and observed handshake serials. Record bootstrap trust for the SDS channel itself so initial connectivity does not depend circularly on a secret that has not yet been fetched.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本課總授權預算200毫秒，剩餘值為預算減各階段耗時；正值只代表時間模型可容納，實際許可仍取決於可信授權回應。 去回網路40毫秒、排隊30毫秒、評估80毫秒，暫將序列化納入評估；所有數字為教學假設，非Envoy基準測試。 餘裕200−40−30−80=50毫秒；排隊增至70時剩10毫秒，不能仍宣稱原來的突發負載容忍度。
本課剩餘輪替時間從舊憑證到期減發布後傳播及採用延遲；ACK只能是中間證據，新連線觀察到的新serial才確認本課指定的採用結果。 舊憑證將於300秒到期，100秒發布，傳播40秒、採用20秒；全部以同一事件起點計時。 餘裕300−100−40−20=140秒；傳播延長至110秒時剩70秒。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: The selected authorization budget is 200 milliseconds, with remaining margin equal to budget minus stage costs. Positive margin means only that the timing model fits; permission still requires a trustworthy allow response. Use 40 milliseconds of round-trip transport, 30 of queueing and 80 of evaluation, including serialization in the latter. These values are teaching assumptions, not an Envoy benchmark or promised deployment latency. Margin is 200−40−30−80=50 milliseconds. Increasing queueing to 70 leaves ten milliseconds, reducing tolerance for additional delay even though the request remains within the nominal budget.

The rotation margin subtracts propagation and adoption delays from old-certificate expiry. ACK is intermediate evidence; the selected acceptance test requires a new connection to observe the replacement serial, rather than relying on a control-plane event alone. The old certificate expires at second 300. Publish at 100, allow 40 seconds for propagation and 20 for adoption, all measured from one event origin. Existing long-lived connections are outside this new-handshake timing model. Margin is 300−100−40−20=140 seconds. Extending propagation to 110 seconds leaves 70. This does not claim that every existing session renegotiates when a new secret arrives.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: SPDX 3.0.1：外部元素映射與完整性解析
related.titleEn: SPDX 3.0.1: external element maps and integrity resolution
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：50與10毫秒可重算，deny、5xx與逾時均不因有餘裕而授權；明確列出哪些設定是課堂政策。 交付ext-authz-timing.csv、四類回應矩陣與v3設定摘要；全部測試離線，不呼叫真實授權端點。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reproduce 50 and ten milliseconds, never turn deny, 5xx or timeout into permission, and identify the settings selected by classroom policy. Deliver ext-authz-timing.csv, the four-response matrix and a v3 configuration summary. All tests are offline and contact no real authorization endpoint.
related.difference: 建立10個外部元素映射，列externalSpdxId、locationHint、definingArtifact及verifiedUsing；本地以兩個不同內容但相同檔名的文件測試關聯。
related.differenceEn: Build ten external maps with externalSpdxId, locationHint, definingArtifact and verifiedUsing. Use two local documents with the same filename but different contents to test whether resolution binds the correct element rather than merely locating a file.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本課總授權預算200毫秒，剩餘值為預算減各階段耗時；正值只代表時間模型可容納，實際許可仍取決於可信授權回應。 去回網路40毫秒、排隊30毫秒、評估80毫秒，暫將序列化納入評估；所有數字為教學假設，非Envoy基準測試。 餘裕200−40−30−80=50毫秒；排隊增至70時剩10毫秒，不能仍宣稱原來的突發負載容忍度。
本課消費政策要求解析到正確元素且完整性符合；規格可選欄位不等於本地安全需求可省略。計數只納入雙條件同時成立者。 10個映射中8個能解析，當中6個完整性可驗證；另外2個無法解析與2個完整性不足分開記錄。 完整可用率6/10×100=60%；補齊一個已解析映射的正確完整性證據後為7/10×100=70%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: The selected authorization budget is 200 milliseconds, with remaining margin equal to budget minus stage costs. Positive margin means only that the timing model fits; permission still requires a trustworthy allow response. Use 40 milliseconds of round-trip transport, 30 of queueing and 80 of evaluation, including serialization in the latter. These values are teaching assumptions, not an Envoy benchmark or promised deployment latency. Margin is 200−40−30−80=50 milliseconds. Increasing queueing to 70 leaves ten milliseconds, reducing tolerance for additional delay even though the request remains within the nominal budget.

The selected consumer policy requires resolution to the intended element and acceptable integrity evidence. A field optional in the interchange format may still be required by this local policy; count only records satisfying both conditions. Eight of ten maps resolve, and six of those have verifiable integrity evidence. Keep two unresolved and two integrity-incomplete cases separate, preserving both the retrieval result and the identity it actually returned. Fully usable coverage is 6/10×100=60 percent. Supplying correct integrity evidence for one already resolved map gives 7/10×100=70 percent, without pretending that unresolved mappings have become available.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
